document_notes: Page 267 of PIR. Contains entry 1322 (Q. Atrius Clonius) which is highly relevant to the PROVINCIA corpus.

entries.relevance_notes: Explicitly attested as Legatus Aug. pro praetore provinciae Thraciae under Caracalla.

segments.name_variants: Tituli: ei positus est Tarraconensis II 4111 = D. 1176 (1) ; nominatur in fastis collegii alicuius sacerdotalis VI 2004 (2), in t. Philippopolitano IGR 1, 717 cf. 1468 (3), in cippo terminali prope Philippopolim reperto Ann. ép. 1929, 14 (4). — Q. Atrius Clonius t. 1. K. Ἄτριος Κλόνιος t. 2. 4. [Q.] Atrius Clonius t. 2. Atrius Clonius dig. 26, 10, 7, 2.
segments.identification_and_sources: Attested in inscriptions from Tarraconensis (CII 4111 = D. 1176), Rome (CIL VI 2004), Philippopolis (IGR 1, 717 cf. 1468; Ann. ép. 1929, 14), and in the Digest (dig. 26, 10, 7, 2).
segments.offices_and_career: Anno 200 cooptatus in collegium sacerdotum nescio quod ex maioribus (fortasse inter sodales Flaviales) t. 2. Epistula Severi et Antonini ad Atrium Clonium citatur ab Ulpiano l. 1 de omn. tribunal. dig. 26, 10, 7, 2; fortasse tunc fuit praetor tutelaris, ut coniecit Stein Thrac. p. 52.
segments.governorship_attestation: Legatus Aug. pro praetore provinciae Thraciae t. 1. 4, regnante (Severo) Antonino
segments.prosopographical_commentary: Discusses his priesthood cooptation in 200 AD, his possible office as praetor tutelaris, and his governorship of Thrace under Caracalla.

governorship_factoids.exact_text: Legatus Aug. pro praetore provinciae Thraciae t. 1. 4, regnante (Severo) Antonino
notes: Governed Thrace during the reign of Caracalla (Severus Antoninus).

career_factoids.exact_text: Anno 200 cooptatus in collegium sacerdotum nescio quod ex maioribus (fortasse inter sodales Flaviales)
notes: Coopted into a major priesthood, possibly the sodales Flaviales.
Conjectured by Stein based on the citation in Ulpian.

related_persons.relation_context: Emperor under whom Q. Atrius Clonius served as legatus

problems.issue: The date range 198-217 for Caracalla's reign is correct, but the text specifies 'regnante (Severo) Antonino', which refers to Caracalla (211-217). The start date should be 211, not 198.
The end date of 217 is correct for Caracalla's reign.
The normalized_name 'Quintus Atrius Clonius' is correct, but the praenomen 'Quintus' is not explicitly attested in the lemma or text. The lemma shows 'Q.' which is abbreviated.
problems.suggested_fix: Use 'Q. Atrius Clonius' for normalized_name to reflect the abbreviation.
